items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The bass player was Eric Peters and the drummer, a French boy, whose name I don't remember. He and Peter were established in Spain. I stayed the Casa Del Loco for two weeks.

ctx.x: Soft music was playing during the time we were waiting. When it was announced that this minister has arrived, and the plane would take off, people started whistling, which has the same meaning as booing. The music immediately became very loud in order to try to keep this fellow from hearing the whistling of dissatisfied people, bit I am certain that he heard it. Later, there was an announcement that the minister wished to excuse himself, because he had no idea that there were other people on the plane. How he…

We left Morocco for France the 21st of April and the 30th, we were in Barcelona, Spain, where I played a new jazz club called Cova del Drac, which means 'Cave of the Dragon'. Left Barcelona on 7th of May, and the 11th, I was in Bilbao at a club called Casa del Loco. Translated in England, it means Crazy House. It was really crazily decorated, but the owners and employers were not crazy. They were two brothers and a pianist who were italians that had lived in Spain for a number of years. They also owned a…
The next interesting thing of 1973 was the jazz festivals of Montreux, Switzerland and Pescara in Italy, a concert in Modena, also in Italy, and the festival of wine in Lilly's home town, Neuchatel.
